name: comp-63
title: Colored Border Textarea
blurb: Textarea with custom indigo border and focus ring.
description: A textarea that overrides the ring color via CSS custom property --ring (indigo-300 light, indigo-900 dark). Focus ring uses the custom color.
use_when: Brand-specific form styling with custom focus ring colors.
avoid_when: You need to keep the default theme colors.
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Custom ring still provides focus visibility.
